entity: INFRAERO - Empresa Brasileira de Infraestrutura Aeroportuária
statement_basis: Individual financial statements (controladora) with equity-method pickup of SPE airport concessions; not full IFRS consolidation of SPEs. Bottom-line after Obras em Bens da União (OBU).
notes: Cash interest paid ('Juros pagos' / 'Empréstimos - Juros') is NOT disclosed as a separate DFC line in any year 2002-2025 reviewed.
Bank/finance debt is negligible for nearly the entire period. DFC financing cash flows are almost exclusively capital contributions, JSCP/dividends, and (rarely) capital reductions.

Only material bank loan identified: Santander working-capital facility R$54.4 mi drawn Oct/2020 (CDI+3.5% a.a., 7-month grace), principal repaid in 2021 (DFC 'Empréstimo Bancário' -54.4). Accrual interest expense 'Juros' = R$9.034 mi in 2021; R$0 thereafter.
Accrual financial expenses are dominated by monetary restatement (SELIC on União capital advances/AFAC), not bank interest.
Small accrual 'Juros' lines in 2017 (0.141) and 2018 (2.567) exist but no corresponding loan balances or DFC loan-interest payments; treated as non-finance-debt / immaterial.
2008/2011/2012 management 'Lucro Líquido' sometimes shown before employee profit-sharing (PLR); table uses DRE bottom line after PLR when that is how the statement presents it.
2013 originally reported -2,654.766; restated in 2014 comparative to -2,767.167. Table uses restated figure.
